label: Wall D6
qualification: Original D6 receiving depths and fine normals retained; the receiving surface is now explicitly tessellated over the actual source-material arch domain. Transparent arch/aperture pixels have no triangles or depth samples. One E boundary sample is a bounded local-plane estimate. Surface geometry is a registered per-view lighting receiver, not an exact hidden masonry solid or a replacement gameplay passage collider.
